channel.title: Unreal Engine on Jesses Tech Art Folio
channel.description: Recent content in Unreal Engine on Jesses Tech Art Folio

item.title: Little Ashton - House Generator
item.description: This post follows the development of a dynamic building generator using Houdini, inspired by Exp33 and Atomfall.

item.title: Dungeon Delve Project
item.description: This post is about a quick diorama project that sets up modular kits, animated portal effects and post process in Unreal Engine.

item.title: Robot Dog Project
item.description: This post documents the retoplogy, rigging, skinning and shader work for creating a game ready animated robot dog.

item.title: Outsource Asset Validator for UE
item.description: This post documents the creation of a asset manager that bakes, validates and imports outsourced meshes with shaders setup into Unreal Engine.

item.title: Winter Shader Musuem
item.description: This project showcases a variety of winter shaders for Unreal Engine 5.

item.title: PCG Scatter Tool Breakdown
item.description: This post documents building a PCG scattering tool for foliage and repetitive assets.

item.title: Visual Mesh Debugger
item.description: This post goes through the development of a visual debugging tool using Python for inspecting static meshes in real-time in Unreal Engine.
